grammar.summary: 本课学习 almost/nearly 与过去时叙事。

points.title: 方位与时间的精确表达
points.explanation: towards evening（将近傍晚）；out of the darkness（从黑暗中），out of = 从……出来。

examples.en: The girl was caught in a storm.

points.title: 过去时叙事巩固
points.explanation: struggled / jumped / found 一连串过去式动作链，叙事紧张感。

examples.en: She had jumped into the water before the boat hit the rocks.
examples.cn: 船撞上礁石前她就跳进了水里。

exercises.q: Don't throw the rubbish ___ the window.
Please come ___ the classroom and join us.
She hopes that she will stand ___ the top of the highest mountain some day.
It is impolite to point ___ people.
I put the laptop ___ your bag.
